// --- file: schema.ts
// Generated by formstand-cli — edit freely, this file is yours.
import { z } from "zod";

export const orgSchema = z.object({
  teams: z.array(z.object({
    name: z.string(),
    members: z.array(z.object({
      email: z.string(),
      phones: z.array(z.string()),
    })),
  })),
});

// --- file: types.ts
// Generated by formstand-cli — edit freely, this file is yours.
import type { z } from "zod";
import { orgSchema } from "./schema";

export type OrgSchema = typeof orgSchema;

// The draft shape the hooks read and write (z.input: what the form
// holds while being filled, before validation refines it).
export type OrgValues = z.input<OrgSchema>;

// --- file: hooks.ts
// Generated by formstand-cli — edit freely, this file is yours.
import { createForm, createFormHooks } from "formstand";
import { orgSchema } from "./schema";
import type { OrgValues } from "./types";

// A form starts blank, and every field here has a legal blank
// state (strings "", booleans false, optional/nullable
// undefined/null), so the draft typechecks as-is; no cast needed.
const initialValues: OrgValues = {
  teams: [],
};

// One module-level form for the whole feature; every file below imports
// these pre-wired hooks instead of receiving `form` via props or a
// provider. A module singleton never unmounts — for a per-mount
// lifecycle, use useForm + createFormContext instead.
export const orgForm = createForm(orgSchema, {
  initialValues,
  mode: "onBlur",
});

export const {
  useOrgField,
  useOrgFieldArray,
  useOrgIsDirty,
  useOrgIsValid,
  useOrgIsSubmitting,
} = createFormHooks(orgForm, "org");

// --- file: sections/TeamsSection.tsx
// Generated by formstand-cli — edit freely, this file is yours.
import { textInputProps } from "formstand";
import {
  useOrgField,
  useOrgFieldArray,
  useOrgIsDirty,
  useOrgIsValid,
} from "../hooks";
import type { OrgValues } from "../types";

export type TeamsSectionProps = Readonly<{ heading?: string }>;

// The array section's hook carries the field array alongside the
// path-scoped flags; row fields bind template paths, so they stay
// schema-typed.
export const useTeamsSection = () => ({
  rows: useOrgFieldArray("teams"),
  dirty: useOrgIsDirty("teams"),
  valid: useOrgIsValid("teams"),
});

const emptyTeamsItem: NonNullable<OrgValues["teams"]>[number] = {
  name: "",
  members: [],
};

const emptyTeamsMembersPhonesItem: NonNullable<(NonNullable<NonNullable<OrgValues["teams"]>[number]["members"]>[number])["phones"]>[number] = "";

const TeamsMembersPhonesRow = ({
  p0,
  p1,
  index,
  onRemove,
}: Readonly<{ p0: number; p1: number; index: number; onRemove: () => void }>) => {
  const field = useOrgField(`teams.${p0}.members.${p1}.phones.${index}`);
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{"Phones #"}{index + 1}</legend>
      <div>
        <label>
          {"Phones"}
          <input {...textInputProps(field)} />
        </label>
        {field.error?.[0] !== undefined ? (
          <p role="alert">{field.error?.[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <button type="button" onClick={onRemove}>
        Remove
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
};

const TeamsMembersPhonesRows = ({
  p0,
  p1,
}: Readonly<{ p0: number; p1: number }>) => {
  const rows = useOrgFieldArray(`teams.${p0}.members.${p1}.phones`);
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{"Phones"}</legend>
      {rows.fields.map((row, index) => (
        <TeamsMembersPhonesRow
          key={row.id}
          p0={p0}
          p1={p1}
          index={index}
          onRemove={() => rows.remove(index)}
        />
      ))}
      {rows.error ? <p role="alert">{rows.error[0]}</p> : null}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => rows.push(emptyTeamsMembersPhonesItem)}>
        {"Add phones"}
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
};

const emptyTeamsMembersItem: NonNullable<NonNullable<OrgValues["teams"]>[number]["members"]>[number] = {
  email: "",
  phones: [],
};

const TeamsMembersRow = ({
  p0,
  index,
  onRemove,
}: Readonly<{ p0: number; index: number; onRemove: () => void }>) => {
  const email = useOrgField(`teams.${p0}.members.${index}.email`);
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{"Members #"}{index + 1}</legend>
      <div>
        <label>
          {"Email"}
          <input {...textInputProps(email)} />
        </label>
        {email.error?.[0] !== undefined ? (
          <p role="alert">{email.error?.[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <TeamsMembersPhonesRows p0={p0} p1={index} />
      <button type="button" onClick={onRemove}>
        Remove
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
};

const TeamsMembersRows = ({
  p0,
}: Readonly<{ p0: number }>) => {
  const rows = useOrgFieldArray(`teams.${p0}.members`);
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{"Members"}</legend>
      {rows.fields.map((row, index) => (
        <TeamsMembersRow
          key={row.id}
          p0={p0}
          index={index}
          onRemove={() => rows.remove(index)}
        />
      ))}
      {rows.error ? <p role="alert">{rows.error[0]}</p> : null}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => rows.push(emptyTeamsMembersItem)}>
        {"Add members"}
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
};

const TeamsRow = ({
  index,
  onRemove,
}: Readonly<{ index: number; onRemove: () => void }>) => {
  const name = useOrgField(`teams.${index}.name`);
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{"Teams #"}{index + 1}</legend>
      <div>
        <label>
          {"Name"}
          <input {...textInputProps(name)} />
        </label>
        {name.error?.[0] !== undefined ? (
          <p role="alert">{name.error?.[0]}</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <TeamsMembersRows p0={index} />
      <button type="button" onClick={onRemove}>
        Remove
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
};

export const TeamsSection = ({
  heading = "Teams",
}: TeamsSectionProps) => {
  const { rows, dirty, valid } = useTeamsSection();
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>
        {heading}
        {dirty ? " — edited" : ""}
        {valid ? "" : " — has errors"}
      </legend>
      {rows.fields.map((row, index) => (
        <TeamsRow
          key={row.id}
          index={index}
          onRemove={() => rows.remove(index)}
        />
      ))}
      {rows.error ? <p role="alert">{rows.error[0]}</p> : null}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => rows.push(emptyTeamsItem)}>
        {"Add teams"}
      </button>
    </fieldset>
  );
};

// --- file: OrgForm.tsx
// Generated by formstand-cli — edit freely, this file is yours.
import { orgForm, useOrgIsSubmitting } from "./hooks";
import { TeamsSection } from "./sections/TeamsSection";

// The form body composes sections; sections compose fields; fields bind
// paths. Nothing in this tree passes `form` — every hook comes pre-wired
// from ./hooks.
export const OrgForm = () => {
  const submitting = useOrgIsSubmitting();
  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={orgForm.handleSubmit((data) => {
        console.log("submit", data);
      })}
    >
      <TeamsSection />
      <button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
        {submitting ? "Submitting..." : "Submit"}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
};

// --- file: index.ts
// Generated by formstand-cli — edit freely, this file is yours.
export { OrgForm } from "./OrgForm";
// The module's public API: the pre-wired hooks, plus the schema and
// draft types consumers need to type their own submit handlers and
// server code.
export * from "./hooks";
export * from "./schema";
export * from "./types";
